name: Wash Away
clause: Cleave {1}{U}{U} / Counter target spell [that wasn't cast from its owner's hand].

needs.proposedSignature: `AltCost.id` 'cleave' plus a face-level alternative effect list — `cleaveAbilities?: Ability[]`, the bracketed-words-removed reading used when the spell was cast for its cleave cost — and a `covers[].by` kind 'cleave' whose anchored line shape is /^cleave (\{.+\})$/
needs.semantics: Cleave (CR 702.148a) is an alternative cost that also CHANGES THE SPELL'S TEXT: casting for the cleave cost removes the words in square brackets, so one face has two different resolutions. `altCosts` today only replaces the cost; there is no way to say which effects a face has depending on how it was cast (the closest analogue, `alt-kicked-amount`, only swaps a magnitude).

needs.proposedSignature: Filter { castFrom?: 'hand' | 'graveyard' | 'exile' | 'command' | 'library' | 'non-hand' } matched against a spell on the stack
needs.semantics: 'Counter target spell that wasn't cast from its owner's hand' restricts a stack target by the zone the spell was cast from. GameObject already records the cast zone (`castWith` / the alt-cost `from`), but `Filter` has no field for it, so the target cannot be narrowed and the counter would hit any spell.
needs.clause: Counter target spell [that wasn't cast from its owner's hand].
